IBBA Segev Game Info

Source: R/ibba_segev.R
ibba_segev_game_info.Rd

Game header: tip-off, competition, both teams and the game state (scores are in the box score).

Endpoint: GET https://stats.segevstats.com/realtimestat_heb/api/?method=getGameInfo

Usage

ibba_segev_game_info(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(integer required): Segev game id (e.g. 50 = Hapoel Be'er Sheva vs Maccabi Tel Aviv, 2025-26 round 1): segev_game_id in ibba_games.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerSegev game id (key space: one flat sequence across seasons and competitions); equals the IBBA ibba_games segev_game_id from 2025-26. Not an IBBA game id.
start_timePOSIXctScheduled tip-off in Israel local time as a naive datetime (the feed has no offset; it can differ from the IBBA tip_off by minutes).
competitioncharacterCompetition name ('Winner League', 'Winner Cup', 'Women', 'Leumit', 'Noar', 'School', 'Preparation Games'): the reliable men's / women's discriminator.
home_team_idintegerHome Segev team id (key space: Segev teams, stable across seasons and competitions; Maccabi Tel Aviv = 2). Not an IBBA team-season id.
home_teamcharacterHome team name in English, upper case; some women's teams end in ' (W)', not all.
home_team_localcharacterHome team name in Hebrew (Latin sponsor words kept).
home_short_namecharacterHome team short name in English, upper case.
away_team_idintegerAway Segev team id (key space: Segev teams, stable across seasons and competitions).
away_teamcharacterAway team name in English, upper case.
away_team_localcharacterAway team name in Hebrew (Latin sponsor words kept).
away_short_namecharacterAway team short name in English, upper case.
periodsintegerRegulation periods in the game (4).
finishedlogicalTrue once the game is final (the wrappers read finished games only).
current_periodintegerCurrent period, the last one played for a finished game (5+ means overtime).
clockcharacterGame clock remaining as 'mm:ss' ('00:00' for a finished game).

Details

The ibba_segev_*() wrappers read Segev Stats, the live-stats vendor behind basket.co.il's game pages (stats.segevstats.com/realtimestat_heb/api/, a JSON-RPC API served as text/html): the game header, rosters, box score, period scores and play-by-play with shot coordinates, from 2025-26. They mirror sdv-py's ibba_segev_* wrappers of the same names: same arguments, the same snake_case columns and types, one row per sdv-py row.

Unofficial and unsupported. The API is keyless, unofficial and not documented for outside use. Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host (429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried three times, a 500 is not); only finished games are read.

Games and ids. game_id is one flat Segev id space across seasons AND competitions (men's Winner League, Winner Cup, women's, Leumit, youth, school and pre-season games), so read competition from ibba_segev_game_info(). There is no game list: league game ids come from ibba_games() segev_game_id (2025-26 on; see ibba_segev_game_crosswalk()). Segev team and player ids are stable across seasons (Jaylen Hoard = player 1000 in games 50 and 419), unlike the IBBA season registrations, and are not IBBA ids.

Play-by-play. Actions name the player by Segev id and by JERSEY number, score reads away-home, and shot x / y are one half-court frame (x 0-1470 across, basket near 735; y out from the baseline, rim near 112-140); which sideline is x = 0 and the metric scale are unverified. Segev renamed its team game stats between 2025-26 and 2026-27; the frames unify them. start_time is the scheduled tip-off in Israel local time (POSIXct, tz Asia/Jerusalem; the feed carries no offset).

Errors are classed conditions, never a warning plus an empty frame: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, "game not found", a finished game with no actions), hoopR_bad_request (HTTP 400 / 422, or a game_id that is not a positive integer) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: another status, a transport error, an empty or non-JSON body, an error or changed envelope, a body for another game, a game that is not final). All inherit hoopR_error.

See also

Other IBBA Segev Functions: ibba_segev_pbp(), ibba_segev_period_scores(), ibba_segev_player_box(), ibba_segev_rosters(), ibba_segev_team_box()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(ibba_segev_game_info(game_id = 50))
#> ── IBBA Segev game info ───────────────────────────────────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 22:15:35 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 15
#>   game_id start_time          competition home_team_id home_team home_team_local
#>     <int> <dttm>              <chr>              <int> <chr>     <chr>          
#> 1      50 2025-10-12 18:40:00 Winner Lea…           11 BEER SHE… "אלטשולר ב\"ש/…
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: home_short_name <chr>, away_team_id <int>,
#> #   away_team <chr>, away_team_local <chr>, away_short_name <chr>,
#> #   periods <int>, finished <lgl>, current_period <int>, clock <chr>
# }
